rows.en: [HERO2]…!?

Tatsuya Todo… You were supposed to be Satoru's friend!

Which means… Kaori's with you too? Why are you doing this!?

Because we hate you people! Kaori's old man, too… He was as good as killed by that failure of a doctor!

And you, protecting her, are the same as him! Get ready!

What!?

Hold on! You're saying the doctor caused the fire? How could you know that!

I won't forgive anyone who lays a hand on [HERO4]!!
[HERO2]…
Let's go, [HERO2]!
Let's go, [HERO2]!

Whoa, close one… Is it too risky to keep going…? Never thought I'd really end up having to pull back.

Just like Satoru said… these guys aren't to be underestimated…
[HERO2], you idiot, idiot, idiooot!! Making me worry this much is so mean! That's a breach of contract!
Hey, hey… Isn't this supposed to be the touching reunion scene? And what do you mean, breach of contract?
No way? You really don't remember? You said you'd "protect" me…
Huh…? I'm the one who wants protecting. When did I ever say that?

Waaah, that's so mean!

In that case… you'll have to treat me to lots of stuff, or it won't be worth it! Liar!

Huh?

My head, again… ow, ow, ow… Ugh… Who am I? Who are you?

You're [HERO2] Kanou… childhood friend of me, [HERO4] Hinata, and a pretty mean hero of justice!

Jeez! Cut it out already! I'm gonna get really mad, [HERO2], you idiot… You don't understand how I feel one bit…
Welcome back, [HERO2]…
Don't leave me alone, [HERO2]…
Defeat all revived Executive Monsters and Shocker Combatants!
Defeat Volhazard!
[HERO4] is defeated
Hmm… I've researched something terrible.
But… if you announce this, Doctor, you'll become famous overnight, won't you?
No, that won't do! I don't intend to announce it anywhere.
Why not? It's a wonderful opportunity…

Shibata… Think about what would happen if someone were to misuse this!

Humanity has used precious scientific achievements for all sorts of evil purposes before…
Then do you intend to throw away this entire invention?

But a scientist can't bury his own invention…

It would be like killing my own child. It's too painful, too great a loss.
How about recording all the equations and how to build this device on microfilm and putting it away?
Mm, let's do that… That's the only way.
So… where will you hide it?

Ha ha ha… I won't tell even you that!

Please don't breathe a word about this "Danger Light" to anyone…
Of course… absolutely not…

This Danger Light is a groundbreaking new energy that can even be converted into plasma energy!

If Dr. Hoshino were still alive, how delighted he would have been…
Space Sheriff Gavan received an astonishing report from Commander Kom of the Galactic Union Police.
What did you say!? My father is alive?
Mm… We've in fact caught an SOS signal from Voicer…
Then he's alive? Your father, Gavan…
In the Earth sector, the only one who can transmit a secret signal is Voicer.
Gavan's father, Voicer, met an Earthling, Tamiko Ichijouji, while posted to Earth as a Space Sheriff. The two married, and Gavan was born.
Voicer fell into the trap of a man who had once been a Space Sheriff and turned traitor, and he vanished. Hearing that his father was alive, held captive by Makuu, Gavan's heart raced.
Then he really is alive?

No, Gavan…

Unfortunately, there is one other!

One other who can transmit a secret signal from the Earth sector… That is Hunter Killer.
It may be a trap to lure you out.
That's right, be on your guard…
…Understood.
…And that's the situation.

What's the connection between this Hunter Killer guy and your father?

And Dr. Hoshino's only daughter… Can we really trust what this woman, Tsukiko Hoshino, says?

Speaking of Dr. Hoshino…

he's the man who was jointly developing a plasma energy generator with Dr. Shirakawa… If she really is the doctor's daughter, I can't imagine she'd lie.

My father, Voicer, was friends with Dr. Hoshino, and they fought Makuu together to protect the plasma energy generator…

But… he was betrayed by the Space Sheriff he'd called for backup, and my father was captured by Makuu. After that, Dr. Hoshino passed away…

That hateful bastard is Hunter Killer, who's now the combat commander of the space crime organization Makuu.
So that's what happened…
According to her, my father is being held at a research facility in Kirifukidani.
So that's a Makuu base? It's certainly the perfect place to hide a hostage.
…I'll go with you! I owe Gavan one… I want to repay it as soon as I can.
Then I'll go as well…
…We'll go with you. With [HERO4]'s "healing power," we can handle getting a little reckless…
You can count on us, Retsu.
Thank you, both of you…
This area is Kirifukidani…
Hiyaaah!!
Who are you? Why are you suddenly attacking me?
Shut up! I'll take you down on behalf of the animals you killed!
What are you talking about? We don't kill animals!
Liar! You're poachers, aren't you? Someone's been running wild on this mountain!
Today's the first time we've ever come to this mountain! Today's the first time!
The first time?
And as proof, we're not carrying a single tool that could be used for poaching…

…!?

I'm so sorry! I jumped to conclusions and mistook you for someone else…

I'm Den Iga, a member of the Forest Patrol! Go ahead… hit me as much as you want!
No… As long as you understand, that's good enough.
Don't say that, give me two or three!
I… don't really like hitting people.

I see…

Then I'll do it myself…
Klutz! Klutz!
Idiot! Jumping to conclusions… Ow…
You said… animals had been killed?

Yeah…

Lately, deer and rabbits have been disappearing one after another. I know the number of little birds living on this mountain, down to the last one!
Oh? Even the number of little birds?

I won't forgive anyone who ravages this mountain! I'll catch 'em… and give 'em a punch!

See you…
Ah, hey…
A Forest Patrol member, huh… He moves just like a wild animal.
Waaagh!!

uncertain: U02332: そいつ (the failed doctor's child = [HERO4]) rendered 'her'; 失敗作の博士 rendered 'that failure of a doctor'
U02344: heroine reintroducing [HERO2] to himself; sentence restructured to keep both tags
U02362/U02377: Dr. Hoshino referred to as 'he' (father of Tsukiko; gender not stated explicitly)
U02368: 一条寺民子 romanized 'Tamiko Ichijouji' (Gavan's mother)
U02401/U02402: narration-kind rows are Den Iga hitting himself
